paperTitle: Claws of Fate: A 2D Adventure Game with BiomesAI for Environmental Education
centralContribution: This work presents Claws of Fate, a 2D adventure game developed in Unity that integrates a customized Artificial Intelligence (AI) system, BiomesAI, to provide real-time, context-sensitive educational guidance on Brazilian biomes (Amazon Rainforest, Caatinga), animal welfare, and environmental conservation. The game aims to foster empathy and responsible pet care in early adolescents through an engaging narrative and personalized AI feedback, showcasing a testbed for generative AI in educational games.

gameObjects.conceptualOrigin: Abstract of Claws of Fate Paper
gameObjects.visualMetaphor: Traditional educational methods often fail to sufficiently engage young audiences in environmental conservation and biodiversity awareness. There is a clear need for immersive, narrative-driven approaches that connect personal experiences, like pet care, to broader ecological responsibilities. While digital games and AI-driven learning are expanding, a gap exists in combining narrative-action gameplay with an adaptive AI companion that provides real-time, contextual knowledge specific to ecological interactions within a game set in diverse national biomes.
This figure showcases the Amazon biome within the game, a critical environment for educating players on Brazilian fauna and flora and environmental conservation.
